title: Local setup and licenses
lead: Start the Web app and configure licenses for local development, native apps or a public host.

rows: Node.js / pnpm
24.19.0 / 10.33.0. Use the versions pinned by the repository.
Web Player / UI
Bitmovin Player 8.281.0 / Player UI 4.23.0, pinned to exact versions.
Browser
A browser that can play HLS or DASH. Codec support, external playback, and low-latency support depend on the environment.
Network
Dependency downloads, license authentication, and external reference streams require connectivity. Running locally does not by itself provide fully offline playback.

blocks.title: Clone and start for the first time
blocks.text:
git clone https://github.com/kazuhide/player-lab.git
cd player-lab
corepack enable
corepack prepare pnpm@10.33.0 --activate
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm --filter @showcase/web dev
Open the startup URL using localhost. The Web SDK can run on this hostname without a Player key. LAN IP addresses, custom hostnames, GitHub Pages and native apps require an appropriate license.

Development mode does not automatically use the public Pages build’s 60-second clips. Basic HLS uses Tears of Steel, DASH uses a public Big Buck Bunny stream, and live playback uses external streams. Some audio, subtitle and image-preview options require configured media URLs.
Create local settings only when needed

blocks.title: Run from the repository root
blocks.text:
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env locally, then synchronize native settings.
bash scripts/sync-env.sh

Edit .env in your editor. Normal settings take precedence in this order: shell environment, root .env, then config/encoding.conf. Explicit Web-specific VITE_* values take priority. Restart the development server after a change; synchronize settings and rebuild native apps.

rows: BITMOVIN_PLAYER_LICENSE_KEY
Client license for the Player. Allow the domains or application identifiers where it will run.
BITMOVIN_ANALYTICS_LICENSE_KEY
Optional client license for collecting playback events. Leave it empty to disable collection.
BITMOVIN_ANALYTICS_API_KEY
Optional server credential for local aggregate queries. Do not pass it to the browser.
BITMOVIN_API_KEY
Server or command-line credential for account API operations. The local Analytics proxy also accepts it as a fallback. Keep it out of client code.

blocks.title: Keep client licenses separate from account API keys
blocks.text: Player and Analytics licenses reach the client. Manage their allowed domains or application identifiers, and use dedicated licenses for a public demo. Keep account API keys on the server, outside VITE_*, HTML and client code.

rows: Web
Vite reads the root .env file. Additional media URLs can be configured in apps/web/.env.
iOS / tvOS
sync-env.sh writes Local.xcconfig. Generate the project with XcodeGen after the first synchronization.
Android
sync-env.sh writes local.properties. Explicit Gradle properties are also supported.
React Native
Move the generated EXPO_PUBLIC_* settings into the Expo project where you integrate the sample.
Vega OS
Set globalThis in the Kepler entry point. See the integration chapter for details.

blocks.text: To publish a fork or another deployment, set both licenses below as GitHub Repository variables and enable the included Pages workflow. Local .env files and inherited VITE_* values do not replace these settings. Pages receives the artifact built and tested by CI.

rows: PLAYER_LAB_PUBLIC_PLAYER_LICENSE_KEY
Dedicated Player license that allows the public host.
PLAYER_LAB_PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_LICENSE_KEY
Dedicated Analytics license that allows the public host.

blocks.text: The current public host is kazuhide.github.io. For another host, check license permissions, paths, Pages settings and applicable terms. License values are included in distributed JavaScript. The current workflow requires both public client licenses and does not use an account API key.
